summary: OpenAI's CFO describes how the company rebuilt its own finance function around ChatGPT and Codex, including custom GPT tools, workflow redesign for close/forecasting, and a framework for measuring AI value.

practices.reason: Describes a concrete pattern of grounding a custom GPT in approved source documents to answer diligence questions, cutting response time from hours to seconds, though the setting is internal and unreplicated.
practices.quote: One result was IR-GPT, a custom GPT grounded in the approved materials our investor relations team uses to answer diligence questions.

practices.reason: Offers a transferable four-question scorecard for judging whether an AI workflow's output is worth its cost, which a team could adapt to grade its own deployments.
practices.quote: For each workflow, ask four questions: Did AI complete work that mattered? What did it cost, including employee time, review, and rework? Was the result good enough to use? Did it help us move faster or make a better decision?
